# Trouble shooting

## Detection history issue - run per site to find where missing species data is

```{r}
# Prepare lists
week_names <- grep("SNNKLC2022week|SNNMSK2022week|SNNMTL2020week|SNSKPE2021week|SNSKPW2021week|SNSLWN2021week|SNSMGN2021week", ls(), value = TRUE) #detection files
cap_names <- grep("SNNKLC2022cap|SNNMSK2022cap|SNNMTL2020cap|SNSKPE2021cap|SNSKPW2021cap|SNSLWN2021cap|SNSMGN2021cap", ls(), value = TRUE) # capture files
site_list <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(week_names, function(name) {
  get(name)$LOC_ID
})))) #full list of sites
week_list <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(week_names, function(name) {
  colnames(get(name))[-1]  # Exclude LOC_ID column
})))) #full list of weeks
species_list <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(cap_names, function(name) {
  unique(get(name)$Species)
})))) #full list of species


# Initialize empty array
y_array <- array(NA, dim = c(length(species_list), length(site_list), length(week_list)),
                 dimnames = list(Species = species_list, Site = site_list, Week = week_list))

# Fill the array from all datasets
# Loop through each pair of cap and week datasets
for (i in seq_along(cap_names)) {
  cap_data <- get(cap_names[i])
  week_data <- get(week_names[i])

  for (w in seq_along(week_list)) {
    week_str <- week_list[w]
    # Subset capture data for current week
    cap_sub <- cap_data %>%
      filter(WEEK == week_str)
    # Subset layout data for current week
    if (!week_str %in% colnames(week_data)) next
    layout_sub <- week_data %>%
      select(LOC_ID, all_of(week_str)) %>%
      rename(op_status = 2)
    for (s in seq_along(site_list)) {
      site <- site_list[s]
      # Get operational status
      site_active <- layout_sub$op_status[layout_sub$LOC_ID == site]
      site_active <- ifelse(length(site_active) == 0, NA, site_active[1])
      for (sp in seq_along(species_list)) {
        species <- species_list[sp]
        if (!is.na(site_active) && site_active == 1) {
          detected <- any(cap_sub$LOC_ID == site & cap_sub$Species == species)
          y_array[sp, s, w] <- ifelse(detected, 1, 0)
        } else if (is.na(y_array[sp, s, w])) {
          y_array[sp, s, w] <- NA
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

# Count detections
detection_totals <- apply(y_array, 1, function(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE))
detection_totals
```

## Error with some sites having empty detection histories

```{r}
d <- dim(y_array)
for (i in seq_along(d)) {
  cnt <- apply(y_array, i, function(slice) sum(!is.na(slice)))
  cat("\n--- Dimension", i, "(length =", d[i], ") ---\n")
  cat("slices with ANY non-NA:", sum(cnt > 0), "of", length(cnt), "\n")
  cat("first 20 counts:"); print(head(cnt, 20))
}


```

## Finding missing sites

```{r}
na_sites <- which(!complete.cases(occ_data$occ.covs))

site_na_report <- lapply(na_sites, function(i) {
  colnames(occ_data$occ.covs)[is.na(occ_data$occ.covs[i, ])]
})

names(site_na_report) <- rownames(occ_data$occ.covs)[na_sites]

site_na_report
```

## Find missing det.covs

```{r}
y <- occ_data$y          # species x sites x visits (array) OR sites x visits (matrix)
det.covs <- occ_data$det.covs
observed_y <- apply(!is.na(y), c(2,3), any)

cov_names <- names(det.covs)

conflict_list <- lapply(cov_names, function(cn) {
  cov_mat <- det.covs[[cn]]
  
  # Ensure shape matches y
  if (!all(dim(cov_mat) == dim(observed_y))) {
    stop(paste("Dimension mismatch for covariate:", cn))
  }
  
  # Conflict = cov is NA AND y has real observation
  conflicts <- is.na(cov_mat) & observed_y
  
  if (any(conflicts)) {
    which(conflicts, arr.ind = TRUE)
  } else {
    NULL
  }
})

names(conflict_list) <- cov_names
conflict_list

```
